column1: # How core reads an `exclude` glob, which every frontend that takes --exclude must read the same way.
# Each line is a glob, a path relative to the source directory, and whether the glob leaves the path
# out, separated by tabs. rstyle-core's tests check this table against core's matcher; a frontend's
# tests can check theirs against a copy.
# A plain path, and a glob that matches a directory, take everything under it.
# `**/` at the start is any number of directories, none included; `/**` at the end is everything
# under; `/**/` in the middle is any number of directories between.
# Character classes. `!` or `^` first negates, `]` first is itself, and `-` first or last is itself.
# Alternatives, which can nest and hold any of the above.
# An empty alternative matches nothing, so `{,x}` is `x`.
# A backslash makes the next character itself.
# Everything else is itself, case included.
